items.title: Sam Dutrey Interview
items.q: we organized a little three piece outfit around the uptown... Jerome Jerry Green, he was playing banjo and drum and I was playing clarinet.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, anyway, that gives us some help on the- Mm-hm. Some of the fellows that were there. And I was gonna ask you then to get back to your life again. If you can tell us some of the very first job you had. You mentioned like sitting in, of course, with George Lewis and people of that kind. But the first job you ever got paid for, can you remember that?

Well, I was still going to school and we organized a little three piece outfit around the uptown, eh? Suddenly, this and Jerome Jerry Green, he was playing banjo and drum and I was playing clarinet. And the first job was opening up a drugstore. Oh, really?
Yeah. Used to have music for, they still do, sometimes when they open a restaurant or something. Oh, yeah.
